import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
assert sys.argv[1:] in (['--probe'], ['--build'])
root=Path('/home/nolan-makatche/AugmentAgent')
target=root/'target'
actual=Path('/mnt/store/augmentagent-session-targets/jarvis-native-producer-repro-e8127483b207b035')
assert os.getuid()==1000 and Path.cwd()==root
assert os.environ['AUGMENTAGENT_PHONE_BUILD_COMMIT']=='3f1e003f000f3bdc4b9c02c1e145abcab70d8f58'
assert target.resolve()==target
assert (target.stat().st_dev,target.stat().st_ino)==(actual.stat().st_dev,actual.stat().st_ino)
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
assert head=='fe2e7b1f50430af73e65bb38049097e959b7a3e3'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no'],text=True).strip()
assert hashlib.sha256((root/'Cargo.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='20f9e0734e86ed443d1810b613d465639ff325f812beb4442e4598e8e91a9810'
assert hashlib.sha256((root/'crates/augmentagent-channel-core/src/native_vm.rs').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='c4259c016eb27a782188687b091a405a66acc152c2e1a3e73268c03b9a50ec9a'
path=Path('/home/nolan-makatche/jarvis-autoship-main-integration/scripts/tests/native_custody_immutable_vm_probe.py')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('repro_storage_validation',path)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
descriptors,observed,scratch=module.managed_storage()
assert observed==target and scratch==target/'tmp'
print(json.dumps({'kind':'path_preserving_build_preflight','uid':os.getuid(),'head':head,'cwd':str(root),'target':str(target),'same_registered_target_inode':True,'actual_inherited_descriptors':len(descriptors),'grants_capacity':False}),flush=True)
wrapper=str(root/'scripts/cargo-managed.sh')
metadata=subprocess.run([wrapper,'metadata','--locked','--no-deps','--format-version','1','--manifest-path',str(root/'Cargo.toml')],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
value=json.loads(metadata.stdout)
package=next(p for p in value['packages'] if p['name']=='augmentagent-cli')
assert value['workspace_root']==str(root),value['workspace_root']
assert value['target_directory']==str(target),value['target_directory']
assert package['manifest_path']==str(root/'crates/augmentagent-cli/Cargo.toml'),package['manifest_path']
print(json.dumps({'kind':'cargo_path_preflight','workspace':value['workspace_root'],'target':value['target_directory'],'cli_manifest':package['manifest_path']}),flush=True)
if sys.argv[1]=='--probe':
    raise SystemExit(0)
subprocess.run([wrapper,'clean','--release','-p','augmentagent-cli','--manifest-path',str(root/'Cargo.toml')],check=True)
raise SystemExit(subprocess.run([wrapper,'build','--release','--locked','--manifest-path',str(root/'Cargo.toml'),'-p','augmentagent-cli','-p','augmentagent-mcp-memory']).returncode)
